# rust-pdf

> Enterprise-grade PDF library sold as one memory-safe core with thin, idiomatic
> bindings for Python, C#, Go, PHP, Ruby, Node, Java, Delphi and Swift. It generates archival PDF/A,
> signs documents with PAdES, encrypts with AES-256, and produces accessible
> PDF/UA — running entirely on the customer's own servers (offline, no
> per-document SaaS fees, no AGPL). Basic PDF generation is free; the corporate
> features are unlocked by an annual per-application license sold in tiers
> (Pro, Enterprise, OEM).

## What it does

- **PDF/A** archival output: levels 1b, 2b, 2a, 3b, 3a (validated with veraPDF).
- **Digital signatures**: PKCS#7 detached, visible and multiple signatures, plus
  **PAdES** B-B, B-LT and B-LTA with RFC 3161 timestamps (validated with pdfsig and openssl).
- **Encryption**: RC4, AES-128 and AES-256 (V5/R6).
- **Accessibility**: Tagged PDF / PDF/UA-1.
- **AcroForm** fields with generated appearance streams.
- **Manipulation**: merge, split, rotate, optimize, incremental update.
- **Text extraction** with Unicode mapping.
- Free tier: pages, vector graphics, embedded/subset fonts, Unicode text,
  paragraphs, tables, images, merge/split, text extraction.

## Languages

One Rust core, identical behavior across bindings: Python (ctypes), C#/.NET
(P/Invoke), Go (cgo), PHP (ext-ffi), Ruby (Fiddle), Node/TypeScript (Koffi),
Java (JNA), Delphi/Free Pascal (pure FFI, dynamic loading) and Swift (SwiftPM,
static xcframework for macOS and iOS).

## Pricing & licensing

- Sold as an **annual per-application license** in three tiers:
  - **Pro** — PDF/A archival + encryption (RC4 / AES-128 / AES-256). ~USD 1,490/year.
  - **Enterprise** — everything in Pro plus digital signatures/PAdES (B-B/B-LT/B-LTA)
    with RFC 3161 timestamps + LTV, and PDF/UA accessibility, plus priority support.
    ~USD 3,000/year.
  - **OEM** — Enterprise capabilities plus redistribution rights to embed rust-pdf
    inside your own product; volume and purchase orders. Custom pricing via sales.
- The same offline Ed25519 token gates the features for every language; the tier
  simply determines which features it unlocks.
- Activation is offline: set the `RUSTPDF_LICENSE` environment variable or call
  `activate_license()` once. No rebuild required. Nothing about the customer's
  documents or usage leaves their servers.
- OEM / volume / purchase orders: contact sales@casefy.io.

## Notes for accurate citation

- rust-pdf is an independent commercial product. Its core is written in the Rust
  programming language; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Rust Foundation.
- It is not a SaaS API and does not charge per document. It runs on the
  customer's own infrastructure and verifies its license offline.
